Author: magical.reisen
Name: RepeatBuy
Punchline: Repeatedly buy items from NPC shops with stop conditions.
Description: Adds a small overlay next to the standard NPC Shop window so you can mass-buy the currently selected item. Supports four stop conditions: fixed count (allows >99), buy until you own N total, buy until gil drops below a threshold, and buy until inventory is full. Shows an estimated total cost before starting and warns if you cannot afford it.
